title: The Lord's Forestructure and the Cycles of Influx
summary: How the Lord prepares containment in advance and how influx descends in continuing cycles. T47 shows that for every disorder the soul will throw up, a holding-place has already been shaped; the holding exists before the thing held. T48 unfolds what the Lord prepares beforehand for every separation — the discrimination is in place before what needs to be discriminated has come into view. T49 describes the four registers in which the proprium has been distributed, including the recurrent Wheel of purification. T50 traces three differently caused conduits of influx through body, perception, and affection. T51 explains how the cycle of regeneration passes through the discrete degrees of the rational without breaking them.
organizing_principle: From forestructure (T47-T48 — what is prepared before the soul falls; ages of separation already appointed) through the great works that hold the proprium in containment (T49 the Wheel) to ongoing cycles (T50-T51 rain through differing conduits; turning without violation). The doctrine is providence: nothing in regeneration is improvised; every operation has been prepared, and the cycles continue without disturbing the orders they pass through.
